entry_shape.prefix: exact serialized command-line text before the unchanged full native PowerShell command; includes actual quoted executable path/options/opening quotes if any
entry_shape.suffix: exact serialized command-line text after the full native PowerShell command; includes closing quotes if any
entry_shape.limit_including_nul: actual positive integer limit for that layer, at most32767; use any smaller actual shell limit

windows_launch_binding.review_binding: fresh independent review must verify the existing selector, actual launcher/config/argument construction, full paths and all layer limits; the boolean is an admission assertion, not proof; retain private binding evidence with preparation

fresh-baseline-selection.json.roots: 1..16 explicit entries, NOT an empty default or historical mapping

entry_shape.child: 1..48 ASCII letters/digits/underscore/hyphen, starts with letter, not reserved Windows device name, one component; distinct case-insensitively

fresh-baseline-selection.json.root_derivation: new setup creates normalized-TEMP/unique-owned-root/preservation/child; no existing tree input allowed

source-inputs/source-manifest.json.archive_bytes: actual bytes of new uncompressed source.tar
source-inputs/source-manifest.json.archive_sha256: same actual archive SHA-256 as preparation
source-inputs/source-manifest.json.files: complete unique export file set; records path/bytes/sha256/git_blob/lf_bytes/crlf_pairs, exact immutable Git bytes
source-inputs/source-manifest.json.archive_rules: safe unique regular members and expected directory entries only; reject links/escape/case aliases; files exact Git export

current_source_snapshot: current-source-manifest.json in this package is a static ed7d96bf reference, not private source-input material or a future parent binding
transport: existing private selector may be read only by a separately tasked future execution; no selector/config/key/credential was inspected here
target_temp: absolute normalized non-root local drive path, no reparse ancestor; fixed legacy scp requires ASCII letters/digits/underscore/dot/hyphen/backslash only after drive; spaces and shell metacharacters refuse before root creation
old_baseline_selection: not read, not created, not required by this new operation
